title: Lawns - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Lawns - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The webpage provides information about Lady Irwin College in Delhi, highlighting its lawns and various resources such as a gallery and photo gallery. It offers contact details, quick links for students, and details on college timing and site visitor information. The college is part of the University of Delhi, holds an A+ NAAC accreditation, and is ranked 31 in the NIRF rankings. Visitors can inquire about admissions and plan visits, with the college open from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm.
